name: Goodreads logged-out homepage by goodreads.com
description: A warm, link-dense community homepage that saves all its colour for one moment: a saturated orange-to-yellow hero band with flat-illustrated readers flanking a large serif headline. A white signup card overlaps the hero's right edge, then the page settles onto a cream paper background and alternates editorial text blocks, book-cover discovery panels and a scannable right rail of news, lists and CTAs. Hierarchy is carried by a serif display face against small sans-serif body text, with dark teal reserved exclusively for navigational links, so even the dense genre and awards directories feel calm and consistent.
